slides.title: Key Market Trends
Strategic Recommendations
slides.body:
1. Lead with signature fashion-and-culture journeys
Fashion, luxury, retail, and experiential themes recur in the captured evidence.
Action: Pilot one Paris itinerary with explicit access, service, and conversion measures.

2. Use AI for drafts with human approval
Technology signals coexist with trust, expertise, and risk themes.
Action: Require specialist review and a source checklist before sending itineraries.

3. Make resilience part of the offer
Risk and disruption signals appear in travel coverage.
Action: Publish escalation, rebooking, traveler-alert, and data-protection commitments.

4. Improve evidence depth
Pricing signals appear on 4 sites and industries on 13 sites.
Action: Review low-yield sources monthly and maintain selectors with fixtures.

5. Operate a monitored monthly scan
Recurring decisions require freshness and source-level quality metrics.
Action: Schedule the pipeline, retain manifests, and alert on coverage or yield regressions.
